## AdaptiveCurveMathLib #5

Swaps the utilization and target operands, inverting the sign of the rate error.

- **Mutant:** [`5.sol`](5.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`hlAciBorrowRateMonotoneInUtilization`](../../specs/AdaptiveCurveIrm/AdaptiveCurveIrm_properties.spec#L121) · [`hlAciBorrowRateMonotoneInUtilizationWithoutAdaptation`](../../specs/AdaptiveCurveIrm/AdaptiveCurveIrm_properties.spec#L180)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh AdaptiveCurveMathLib 5`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/AdaptiveCurveIrm/properties.conf --rule hlAciBorrowRateMonotoneInUtilization hlAciBorrowRateMonotoneInUtilizationWithoutAdaptation`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/adaptive-curve-irm/libraries/AdaptiveCurveMathLib.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/adaptive-curve-irm/libraries/AdaptiveCurveMathLib.sol
@@ -80,7 +80,7 @@
         int256 utilization =
             int256(market.totalSupplyAssets > 0 ? market.totalBorrowAssets.wDivDown(market.totalSupplyAssets) : 0);
         int256 errNormFactor = utilization > targetUtilization ? WAD - targetUtilization : targetUtilization;
-        return (utilization - targetUtilization).wDivToZero(errNormFactor);
+        return (targetUtilization - utilization).wDivToZero(errNormFactor);
     }

     /// @dev Returns the rate for a given `_rateAtTarget` and an `err`.
```

## AdaptiveCurveMathLib #7

Flips the sign test picking the curve coefficient, applying the steep slope below target.

- **Mutant:** [`7.sol`](7.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`hlAciBorrowRateWithinAmplifiedConfigBand`](../../specs/AdaptiveCurveIrm/AdaptiveCurveIrm_properties.spec#L89) · [`hlAciBorrowRateWithinAmplifiedBandOnFirstInteraction`](../../specs/AdaptiveCurveIrm/AdaptiveCurveIrm_properties.spec#L159)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh AdaptiveCurveMathLib 7`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/AdaptiveCurveIrm/properties.conf --rule hlAciBorrowRateWithinAmplifiedConfigBand hlAciBorrowRateWithinAmplifiedBandOnFirstInteraction`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/adaptive-curve-irm/libraries/AdaptiveCurveMathLib.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/adaptive-curve-irm/libraries/AdaptiveCurveMathLib.sol
@@ -89,7 +89,7 @@
     ///     ((C-1)*err + 1) * rateAtTarget else.
     function _curve(int256 _rateAtTarget, int256 err, int256 curveSteepness) internal pure returns (int256) {
         // Non negative because 1 - 1/C >= 0, C - 1 >= 0.
-        int256 coeff = err < 0 ? WAD - WAD.wDivToZero(curveSteepness) : curveSteepness - WAD;
+        int256 coeff = err > 0 ? WAD - WAD.wDivToZero(curveSteepness) : curveSteepness - WAD;
         // Non negative if _rateAtTarget >= 0 because if err < 0, coeff <= 1.
         return (coeff.wMulToZero(err) + WAD).wMulToZero(_rateAtTarget);
     }
```

     ///     ((C-1)*err + 1) * rateAtTarget else.
     function _curve(int256 _rateAtTarget, int256 err, int256 curveSteepness) internal pure returns (int256) {
         // Non negative because 1 - 1/C >= 0, C - 1 >= 0.
